rows.name: Maoli Farms
rows.notes: Own site lists the Windward Mall Farmers Market booth, Sundays 10-2 upstairs, and also on the Plenty of Aloha organizer vendor list. Instagram handle @maolifarms comes from an Instagram post embedded on the business's own news page. Site says orders need a 10% deposit and Oʻahu delivery has a $30 minimum; it shows a cart but I did not find a specific order URL. Based in Kailua (windward); the site also describes a native forest project in Whitmore Estates (central Oʻahu). Facebook not found.

rows.name: Ohana Fresh Produce
rows.notes: Listed as a current vendor at the Mānoa Marketplace Farmers Market (Tue/Thu/Sun 7am-2pm) and has a Hawaii Farm Bureau vendor page (Asian vegetables, tropical fruit, herbs, cut fruit). The Mānoa listing is about 17 months old and marked 'subject to change', so current status is unconfirmed. No own website or social accounts found. Not related to Hawaiʻi Foodbank's 'Ohana Produce Plus' program.

rows.name: Orathai Farm

rows.name: Organic Turmeric
rows.notes: Matched to Organic Turmeric Treasures, Waimānalo (Plenty of Aloha lists it as 'Organic Turmeric'). The Facebook page names the same location and website domain. Honolulu Magazine's farmers market guide (published about 19 days ago) lists it at Windward Mall (Sun 10-2, Wed 2-6). Honolulu Magazine also placed it at FarmLovers Market in Kakaʻako. Not the same as Aloha Turmeric (also Waimānalo). Instagram not found; website domain taken from the Facebook intro and not opened.
